messages:
alex: Noticed a few embed telemetry rows with emails slipping through. low volume but reproducible. :grimacing:

maria: Which route? SDK or direct API?

alex: /v1/realtime/embed, mix of both. client scrub misses some shorthand emails.
devon: Short-term: ingress should redact by default. Long-term: store encrypted raw + serve redacted copies.
sam: Need opt-in for enterprise raw logs. And tenant caps so sampling doesn't explode costs.
jess: Console UX: show redacted preview, require justification + 2FA for unmask. auto-reseal after 1h.
maria: I'll push a quick regex scrub to ingress canary: `re.sub(r"[\w._%+-]+@[\w.-]+\\.[a-z]{2,}", "[REDACTED_EMAIL]", payload)` and add redaction_misses metric.
devon: Also add header hints `X-Redact-Hint` but treat as advisory only. Final redaction is server-side deterministic.
sam: Proposal: quota-aware sampling: base_rate per-route, spike_mode on anomalies up to tenant_max per day. draft RFC?

infra-bot: deploybot: canary deploy ingress-scrubber v3 -> prod/us-west-2 started (build 6801).

alex: Action: devon+sarah draft RFC EOW, jess mock console by Tue, sam calc cost delta. If any high-severity leaks found, pause embedding telemetry export. :thumbsup:
